written: 25 duties, holders and doors. Exit test met for 24 of 25 duties (gas and pipelines open: FAIL RF-007; airport, water and gas utility not fingerprinted: RF-008).

Run failures register opened (owner request): every failure of this run gets an RF- row with kind, severity, revisit priority (P0 to P3, owner-adjustable), retry rule and status. Stage B failures are RF-001 to RF-009; Hamilton's carried-forward failures are RF-010 to RF-013.
Method v0.2 adopted by the owner (MC-002, D-094): run failures register in every stage.
Stage C: Enumerate
Sweep A: every stage B door enumerated in full; 617 title-screened candidates across 9 publishers. Sample of 60 (seed 20261119): precision 0.43, about 267 relevant.
Sweep B: 15 duty-driven searches, without consulting A. 24 distinct public datasets; documents, PDFs, commercial and restricted finds recorded separately.

Overlap: 15 of B's 24 in A (two automatic matches corrected by hand). FAIL RF-015 to RF-019: five doors found only by B (Census, county planning server, air district portal and emissions, EPA risk management plans, GeoTracker without a second door).
Capture–recapture: about 427 (Lincoln–Petersen), 418 (Chapman). Two sweeps hold roughly two thirds. Rough: B small, not fully independent.
City boundary is a line, not a polygon (SP-013); closed into a polygon for filtering.

County narrowing test on the assessor parcel layer: tax-rate city 5,459, all inside the boundary; situs city 5,091; 370 city parcels with blank situs (349 single space, 21 null). FAIL RF-020, resolved by using tax-rate city; lesson LL-005.
Count sprints on 18 city services (parcels 5,499; zoning 440 to 460 in three versions; General Plan two versions; 109 oil wells; 23 developments).
